```sql
-- 日別の出勤者数を集計する関数
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_daily_attendance_counts_for_month(start_date date, end_date date)
RETURNS TABLE(date date, count bigint) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        a.date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS count
    FROM
        attendance.attendances AS a
    WHERE
        a.date >= start_date AND a.date <= end_date AND a.type = 'in'
    GROUP BY
        a.date
    ORDER BY
        a.date;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- 特定の日の班・学年別出勤詳細を集計する関数
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_daily_attendance_details(for_date date)
RETURNS TABLE(team_name text, generation integer, user_count bigint) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH daily_attendees AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT user_id
        FROM attendance.attendances
        WHERE date = for_date AND type = 'in'
    )
    SELECT
        COALESCE(t.name, '未所属') AS team_name,
        m.generation,
        COUNT(m.supabase_auth_user_id) AS user_count
    FROM
        member.members m
    JOIN
        daily_attendees da ON m.supabase_auth_user_id = da.user_id
    LEFT JOIN
        member.member_team_relations mtr ON m.supabase_auth_user_id = mtr.member_id
    LEFT JOIN
        member.teams t ON mtr.team_id = t.id
    WHERE
        m.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY
        t.name, m.generation
    ORDER BY
        team_name, m.generation;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

title: "get_daily_attendance_counts_for_month (0001_create_attendance_schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive start_date, end_date parameters
    q_validate --> q_query: SELECT date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM attendance.attendances
    q_query --> q_filter: WHERE date >= start_date AND date <= end_date AND type = 'in'
    q_filter --> q_group: GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
    q_group --> [*]: RETURN TABLE(date, count)

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: Function is not SECURITY DEFINER (runs with caller privileges)
        INV-002: No input validation on date range (start_date could be after end_date)
        INV-003: Only counts 'in' type records (ignores 'out')
        INV-004: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) prevents double-counting users with multiple check-ins
    end note

title: "get_daily_attendance_details (0001_create_attendance_schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive for_date parameter
    q_validate --> q_cte: CTE daily_attendees = SELECT DISTINCT user_id WHERE date = for_date AND type = 'in'
    q_cte --> q_join: JOIN member.members ON supabase_auth_user_id = user_id
    q_join --> q_left_join_team: LEFT JOIN member.member_team_relations, member.teams
    q_left_join_team --> q_filter: WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
    q_filter --> q_group: GROUP BY team_name, generation ORDER BY team_name, generation
    q_group --> [*]: RETURN TABLE(team_name, generation, user_count)

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: Function is not SECURITY DEFINER (runs with caller privileges)
        INV-002: Soft-delete aware (filters deleted_at IS NULL)
        INV-003: COALESCE(t.name, 'unassigned') handles members without team
        INV-004: LEFT JOIN ensures members without team assignments are still counted
        INV-005: Only counts 'in' type attendance (consistent with counts function)
    end note

title: "security_privilege_fix (0001_create_attendance_schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_member_rls: ENABLE + FORCE RLS on all member tables
    q_member_rls --> q_revoke_member_anon: REVOKE ALL ON member tables FROM anon
    q_revoke_member_anon --> q_fix_member_defaults: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES REVOKE ALL FROM anon in member schema

    q_add_missing_policies --> q_revoke_attendance_anon: REVOKE ALL ON attendances, users, daily_logout_logs FROM anon

    q_tighten_temp --> q_grant_temp_select: GRANT SELECT ON temp_registrations TO anon
    q_grant_temp_select --> q_fix_attendance_defaults: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES REVOKE ALL FROM anon in attendance schema
    q_fix_attendance_defaults --> q_force_attendance_rls: FORCE RLS on all attendance tables
    q_force_attendance_rls --> q_grant_rpc: GRANT EXECUTE ON record_attendance_by_card(text) TO anon
    q_grant_rpc --> [*]: security hardened

    note right of q_revoke_member_anon
        INV-001: anon loses all direct table access on member schema
        INV-002: FORCE RLS prevents bypass even for table owner
    end note

    note right of q_tighten_temp
        INV-003: anon retains SELECT on temp_registrations (required for Realtime QR subscription)
        INV-004: anon can only call record_attendance_by_card RPC (SECURITY DEFINER handles internal access)
        INV-005: Idempotent policy creation using DO block with existence check
